notes: Section 11 (Bernal Heights, Silver Terrace, Bayview, Bay View Park; joins Sec. 9 above, 12 left, 10 right), 1-bit photocopy on a wide 6600x3308 page: the sheet sits in the middle (x ~2290-4480), blank paper left and right of it. Page turned ~0.6 deg (top rule y 277 at the left to 303 at the right; left rule x 2334 at the top to 2308 at the bottom). Frame on all four sides: thick bar, white hairline, thin inner rule (the innermost rule), with a thick + thin quarter arc in every corner. The outline lies on paper 1-2 px inside the thin rule's inner edge (README rules 1, 8), points every <=60 px. On the right side the thin rule drops out of the copy at y ~2180-2200 and ~2250-2272; the outline keeps the fitted line there (it wobbles 1-2 px with the ragged rule between y 2180 and 2300). Corners (rule 2): the outline follows the inner edge of the thin arc 1-2 px inside it; each arc's tail runs a little way beside its side rule before joining it, and the outline goes round the tail, so the tail and the gap between tail and rule are outside (TL: tail beside the left rule down to y 409, band end on the top rule at x 2465; TR: x 4330 on the top rule, y 433 on the right rule; BL: tail beside the left rule from y 2948, x 2436 on the bottom rule; BR: y 2961 on the right rule, x ~4284 on the bottom rule). Kind (b), map ink that truly touches the frame and is left under the outline: the cross-hatched (industrial) blocks run into the bottom rule along x ~3100-4290, into the right rule along y ~1480-2960 and into the top rule along x ~3230-3960, so long stretches of the outline there lie on block ink; street, lot and hatch lines touch the left rule (y ~470-2250), the top rule (x ~2600-3200) and the right rule (y ~1000-1480); at x 2692-2717 a map line runs 1 px under the top rule and the outline keeps to the 1-px paper gap, crossing the line where it meets the rule. BR corner: the cross-hatched blocks run across the thin arc and into the corner; the outline follows the arc's inner edge through them (the block parts beyond the arc are outside, rule 2), and at both arc ends it crosses block ink that touches the arc (y 2960, x 4284-4300). remove: (1) the CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP title, LEGEND swatches and the 1000 scale bar (top right, no ruled box, on blank paper between the blocks on its left and below it), a rectangle 4-6 px outside its ink with the top-right corner cut off inside the TR arc (left edge in the 5 ink-free columns x 3980-3984, bottom edge in the 4 ink-free rows y 702-705); it also covers the SECTION badge; (2) the compass rose with its true-north arrow (tip 4297,730), the magnetic needle (tip 4364,743) and the tail feather (down to y 1206): the rose stands on blank paper between blocks, the needle's tail runs down a street between block outlines and the tail feather touches a block corner at y ~1195-1206, so the 16-point outline hugs the needle (about 12 px each side) and crosses that block edge and one lot line (remove-outline ink ~13); (3) the SECTION 11 badge (ring centre 4368.6,390.1, outer radius 35.9), an octagon 3 px outside the ring: the Y of PROPERTY touches the ring on its left, so the octagon crosses that letter (it lies inside the title rectangle anyway). 'Join Sec.' lettering prints outside the frame. Doubt: the BR corner, where block ink is merged with the arc and both rules and the frame's own edge is read from the fitted arc and the neighbouring clean stretches.
drawn_by: Claude (training-label agent LA, issue #71), 2026-11-21: from the scan and inputs/frame-labels/README.md only (no model output looked at). Sides: inner edge of the innermost (thin) rule measured every 2nd px from luminance profiles (thin run beside the bar), robust local-linear fit, then each px of the outline re-set 2 px inside the rule's measured inner end where paper lies inside it (within 1.5 px of the fit; the fit kept where map ink is merged with the rule). Corner arcs: circle fitted to the arc band's inner edge along rays, plus the measured residual by angle; arc ends (stubs) hand-placed from pixel dumps. Remove blocks from full-resolution crops. Checked on straightened 3x/6x strips of the whole outline (every vertex), pixel dumps of all eight arc ends, and the ranked ink stretches.
